H7484G.name: Raamah
H7484G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H7484G.brief: Son of Cush, grandson of Ham, great-grandson of Noah
H7484G.short: Raamah was a son of Cush, grandson of Ham, and great-grandson of Noah, mentioned in the Table of Nations.

H7410H.name: Ram
H7410H.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H7410H.brief: Firstborn son of Jerahmeel, of the tribe of Judah
H7410H.short: Ram was the firstborn son of Jerahmeel, from the tribe of Judah.

H7410I.name: Ram
H7410I.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H7410I.brief: Ancestor of Elihu, who spoke to Job
H7410I.short: Ram was an ancestor of Elihu, one of the men who spoke to Job.

H7410G.name: Ram
H7410G.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H7410G.brief: Son of Hezron, ancestor of David and Jesus
H7410G.short: Ram was the son of Hezron and an ancestor of King David and Jesus Christ.

H7435.name: Ramathites
H7435.brief: People from Ramah who tended King David's vineyards
H7435.short: The Ramathites were people from Ramah who were in charge of King David's vineyards.

H7422.name: Ramiah
H7422.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7422.brief: One of the men who married foreign women
H7422.short: Ramiah was one of the men who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra.

H7497A.name: Rapha
H7497A.desc: Giant living at the time of United Monarchy
H7497A.brief: Ancestor of Philistine giants; his descendants fought against David's warriors.
H7497A.short: Rapha was the ancestor of several Philistine giants who fought against David and his mighty warriors.

H7498G.name: Raphah
H7498G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7498G.brief: Son of Binea, a descendant of King Saul
H7498G.short: Raphah (or Rephaiah) was a son of Binea and a descendant of King Saul.

H7480.name: Reelaiah
H7480.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7480.brief: One of the leaders who returned with Zerubbabel
H7480.short: Reelaiah (or Raamiah) was one of the leaders who returned to Jerusalem with Zerubbabel after the Babylonian exile.

H7472.name: Rei
H7472.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H7472.brief: A supporter of Solomon during Adonijah's rebellion
H7472.short: Rei was one of the people who remained loyal to King Solomon during Adonijah's attempt to seize the throne.

H7425.name: Remaliah
H7425.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7425.brief: Father of Pekah, king of Israel
H7425.short: Remaliah was the father of Pekah, who became king of Israel and reigned for 20 years.

H7497B.name: Rephaim
H7497B.brief: A race of giants who inhabited Canaan
H7497B.short: The Rephaim, also known as Zamzummin, were a race of giants who inhabited parts of Canaan before the Israelite conquest.

H7466.name: Reu
H7466.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H7466.brief: Son of Peleg, ancestor of Abraham
H7466.short: Reu was the son of Peleg and an ancestor of Abraham, living to the age of 239 years.

H7467H.name: Reuel
H7467H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7467H.short: Reuel was a Benjamite mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

H7467G.name: Reuel
H7467G.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H7467G.brief: Son of Esau and Basemath, a chief of Edom
H7467G.short: Reuel was a son of Esau and Basemath, and he became a chief in the land of Edom.

H7417B.name: Rimmon
H7417B.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H7417B.brief: Father of Baanah and Rechab, murderers of Ish-bosheth
H7417B.short: Rimmon was a Beerothite and the father of Rechab and Baanah, who murdered Ish-bosheth, Saul's son.

H7441.name: Rinnah
H7441.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7441.brief: Son of Shimon, of the tribe of Judah
H7441.short: Rinnah was a son of Shimon, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

H7484H.name: Raamah
H7484H.brief: A trading partner of Tyre, possibly in Arabia
H7484H.short: Raamah was a place, possibly located in Arabia, that traded with the city of Tyre, offering spices, precious stones, and gold.

H7486H.name: Raamses
H7486H.brief: A store city built by the Israelites in Egypt
H7486H.short: Raamses was one of the store cities built by the Israelites during their enslavement in Egypt, along with Pithom.

H7414G.name: Ramah
H7414G.brief: A town in Benjamin, near Gibeah and Jerusalem
H7414G.short: Ramah was a town in the territory of Benjamin, often associated with significant events in Israel's history, such as the mourning of Rachel and the imprisonment of Jeremiah.

H7414H.name: Ramah
H7414H.brief: A town on the border of Asher and Tyre
H7414H.short: Ramah was a town located on the border between the territory of Asher and the city-state of Tyre.

H7414I.name: Ramah
H7414I.brief: A fortified city in the territory of Naphtali
H7414I.short: Ramah was a fortified city located in the territory of Naphtali, mentioned in the list of cities allocated to the tribe during the division of the Promised Land.

H7437.name: Ramath-lehi
H7437.brief: The place where Samson killed a thousand Philistines
H7437.short: Ramath-lehi, meaning "hill of the jawbone," was the place where Samson killed a thousand Philistines with the jawbone of a donkey.

H7486G.name: Rameses
H7486G.brief: Egyptian city where Israelites lived before the Exodus
H7486G.short: Rameses was a city in Egypt where the Israelites lived during their enslavement before the Exodus (<ref="Gen. 47:11; Exo. 12:37">Gen. 47:11; Exo. 12:37</ref>).

H7432.name: Remeth
H7432.short: Remeth, also called Ramoth, was a Levitical city allotted to the tribe of Issachar (<ref="Jos. 19:21; 1Ch. 6:73">Jos. 19:21; 1Ch. 6:73</ref>).

H7497G.name: Rephaim Valley
H7497G.brief: Valley near Jerusalem, site of battles
H7497G.short: The Valley of Rephaim was a valley near Jerusalem where David fought the Philistines (<ref="2Sa. 5:18, 22; 23:13; 1Ch. 11:15; 14:9">2Sa. 5:18, 22; 23:13; 1Ch. 11:15; 14:9</ref>).

H7449.name: Resen
H7449.brief: Ancient Assyrian city built by Nimrod
H7449.short: Resen was an ancient Assyrian city built by Nimrod between Nineveh and Calah (<ref="Gen. 10:12">Gen. 10:12</ref>).

H7417C.name: Rimmon
H7417C.brief: Rock where Benjamites fled after battle
H7417C.short: Rimmon was a rock where 600 Benjamite survivors fled after a battle with the other Israelite tribes (<ref="Jdg. 20:45, 47; 21:13">Jdg. 20:45, 47; 21:13</ref>).

H7417I.name: Rimmon
H7417I.brief: A town in Judah and Simeon
H7417I.short: Rimmon, a town allotted to Judah and later given to Simeon, was located in the Negev region.

H7428.name: Rimmon-perez
H7428.short: Rimmon-perez was a place where the Israelites camped during their journey from Egypt to Canaan (<ref="Num. 33:19-20">Num. 33:19-20</ref>).

H7446.name: Rissah
H7446.short: Rissah was a place where the Israelites camped during their journey from Egypt to Canaan (<ref="Num. 33:21-22">Num. 33:21-22</ref>).

H7417A.name: Rimmon
H7417A.brief: A Syrian deity worshipped by Naaman
H7417A.short: Rimmon was a Syrian deity worshipped by Naaman, who asked for God's pardon for bowing down in Rimmon's temple (<ref="2Ki.5.18">2Ki.5.18</ref>).
